purpose.zh: 活动手腕，为支撑类动作做准备
purpose.en: Mobilize your wrists to prepare for weight-bearing work.

text.zh: 身体前后移动重心，力度由轻到重
text.en: Rock your weight forward and back, starting light and building up

text.zh: 手指依次朝前、朝侧、朝后，最后手背着地
text.en: Turn your fingers forward, sideways, back, then rest on the backs of your hands.
Keep your arms straight and your knees steady.

commonErrors.en: Putting full weight on the wrists right away.

commonErrors.zh: 只做手指朝前一个方向

cautions.zh: 手腕刺痛或发麻就停止
cautions.en: Stop if your wrists feel sharp pain or numbness.
